svg.title: FootballIQ complete end-to-end architecture
svg.desc: Full pipeline from Kaggle source data through Azure Data Lake Storage, Unity Catalog External Location, Bronze ingestion with lineage columns, Silver transformation including SCD Type 2 dimensions and FK validation with quarantine, Gold business aggregates, Databricks Workflow orchestration, and Power BI serving layer.
svg.text: Other dims: dim_competitions, dim_countries — cast + dedupe only

g.text: Inner join check: player_id, game_id must exist in dims

svg.text: fact_games, fact_appearances written via MERGE INTO (idempotent upsert)
Quarantined rows tagged with reason code (e.g. FK_VIOLATION)
Aggregated with window functions for season/competition rankings
No cleaning here — only reads from validated Silver tables

g.text: bronze_ingest → silver_transform → gold_aggregate, email on failure
